lead: A goal record's `nvs-suite` check can name `.nvst` paths in a directory layout the corpus never adopted.
body: The failure reads exactly like unwritten work; the corpus is flat directories with a subsystem prefix on the file name (`tests/conformance/core/io-…`), not `tests/conformance/io/…`, and a drafted name describes the *claim*, which is usually already pinned under the name the corpus took — sometimes as an `nvs-stdlib` `#[test]`, when it is a panic no `.nvst` can survive. `sed -n 2p` the plausible neighbours before writing a case to satisfy a name.
